_about: Malady Wise health-days calendar. Used by the monthly puzzle build and the home page. kind=day: theme every puzzle that day around puzzle_theme. kind=week: theme the first day only. kind=month: no full themed day; slip 2-4 related puzzles in across the month. tags: specialty = profession day; who = official WHO campaign; zebra = rare-disease angle; gentle = respectful tone, no jokes about patients or the condition; sensitive = home-page blurb only, puzzles NOT themed. If two days share a date, the lowest priority number leads (1 specialty, 2 WHO, 3 other); the other gets a mention in the blurb. Dates for variable days are pre-computed for 2026-2028; recompute from 'rule' for later years. Verify links before publishing; blurbs use Australian spelling.
